title: Oddly Oven Roasted Middle Eastern Kiwifruit Tagine
description: A funky and flaky Middle Eastern dish featuring kiwifruit and nuka-pickle, perfect for a sick day, and is fodmap-friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, ground cumin, ground coriander, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chopped kiwifruit and nuka-pickle to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
Transfer the kiwifruit mixture to a baking dish and pour in the chicken broth.
Cover the baking dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 20 minutes, or until the kiwifruit is tender.
Remove the dish from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
